description: Read the metamodel properties of one element of a parsed model by their KerML/SysML specification names — inheritedFeature, connectorEnd, relatedFeature, directedFeature, isComposite, a feature's value… — as the model's API element form (convert to api-json) spells them (the GetElementProperties RPC). The element is named by qualified name, by the positional id of an unnamed member (Owner::@2) or by the id an earlier answer's element value carried, which walks the model and into the standard library; empty properties reads every property the element carries. A property the metaclass does not declare, or OpenSysML does not derive for the element, answers `unsupported` with the reason. An unknown element answers with `error` set rather than failing. A document with a syntax error, or one declaring a name an earlier document declares, is left out and listed in `excludedDocuments`; only its own elements answer its error. The result is the GetElementPropertiesResponse as protojson writes it.

elementId.description: the element: a qualified name (Demo::Vehicle::mass), the positional id of an unnamed member (Demo::Vehicle::@2), or the id an earlier answer's element value carried, a standard-library element's included

lookup.description: what elementId is, stated rather than guessed: LOOKUP_KIND_QUALIFIED_NAME reads it only as a qualified name, LOOKUP_KIND_ELEMENT_ID only as an id an answer reported (a childIds or members entry, a positional id as Owner::@3, an unnamed connector end's id); empty reads a name first, then an id

modelHash.description: the model_hash a parse answered; give this, or paths and/or sources to parse first

paths.description: model files to parse as one model, absolute or relative to the workspace root

properties.description: the properties to read by their KerML/SysML specification names, as inheritedFeature, connectorEnd, isComposite; empty reads every property the element carries

sources.description: documents given inline, parsed with paths as one model

language.description: sysml or kerml; empty is inferred from path's extension, sysml when it has none

path.description: name the document is reported by in diagnostics and indexed under; a .kerml extension makes it KerML unless language says otherwise

text.description: the document's source text; empty is an empty document

strictConformance.description: judge the documents as conforming SysML v2: notation no pinned production admits is an error rather than a warning

name: element_properties
